newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Feb CPI up 0.6 pct m/m - CSO.
newsitem.headline: Irish Feb CPI up 0.6 pct m/m - CSO.

text.p: The Irish February consumer price index was up 0.6 percent on January 1997 and up 1.5 percent year-on-year, the Central Statistics Office said on Thursday.
This is the second monthly Irish consumer price data and brings Ireland into line with the rest of the European Union.
Up until January 1997, the CSO had released the CPI on a quarterly basis.
Market forecasts for the CPI had ranged from 0.5 to 1.0 percent month-on-month and from 1.5 to 1.9 percent year-on-year.
The European Union harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP), which is used for intra-EU comparisons, showed a +0.6 percent rise on January and was up 1.7 percent on February last year.
